Grace hopes to visit Rome one day. Life is full of small surprises. Last Tuesday, Grace and Eva went to the old town. What's more, we went downtown to do some shopping.
Both of them like noodles and water. Grace plays badminton with Eva every Tuesday. Grace is going to travel to Rome in November. Best of all, the school holds a yearly sports day.
